units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
If you please, my dear.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Goes off to the left, calling.
Mr. Constantine! Oh, Mr. Constantine!
units.name: MASHA

units.text: Comes in from behind the stage.
I see that the play will never be finished, so now I can go home. Good evening.
units.name: NINA

units.text: She kisses ARKADINA and PAULINA.
Bravo! Bravo!
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Bravo! Bravo! We were quite charmed by your acting. With your looks and such a lovely voice it is a crime for you to hide yourself in the country. You must be very talented. It is your duty to go on the stage, do you hear me?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: It is the dream of my life, which will never come true.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Who knows? Perhaps it will. But let me present Monsieur Boris Trigorin.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: I am delighted to meet you.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Embarrassed.
I have read all your books.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Drawing NINA down beside her.
Don’t be afraid of him, dear. He is a simple, good-natured soul, even if he is a celebrity. See, he is embarrassed himself.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Couldn’t the curtain be raised now? It is depressing to have it down.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Loudly.
Jacob, my man! Raise the curtain!
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: To TRIGORIN.
It was a curious play, wasn’t it?
units.name: NINA

units.text: Very. I couldn’t understand it at all, but I watched it with the greatest pleasure because you acted with such sincerity, and the setting was beautiful.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: A pause.
There must be a lot of fish in this lake.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: Yes, there are.
units.name: NINA

units.text: I love fishing. I know of nothing pleasanter than to sit on a lake shore in the evening with one’s eyes on a floating cork.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: Why, I should think that for one who has tasted the joys of creation, no other pleasure could exist.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Don’t talk like that. He always begins to flounder when people say nice things to him.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: I remember when the famous Silva was singing once in the Opera House at Moscow, how delighted we all were when he took the low C. Well, you can imagine our astonishment when one of the church cantors, who happened to be sitting in the gallery, suddenly boomed out: “Bravo, Silva!” a whole octave lower. Like this:
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: In a deep bass voice.
“Bravo, Silva!” The audience was left breathless.
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: A pause.
An angel of silence is flying over our heads.
units.name: DORN

units.text: I must go. Good-bye.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Where to? Where must you go so early? We shan’t allow it.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: My father is waiting for me.
units.name: NINA

units.text: How cruel he is, really.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: They kiss each other.
Then I suppose we can’t keep you, but it is very hard indeed to let you go.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: If you only knew how hard it is for me to leave you all.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Somebody must see you home, my pet.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Startled.
No, no!
units.name: NINA

units.text: Imploringly.
Don’t go!
units.name: SORIN

units.text: I must.
units.name: NINA
